workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether structurally valid warmup-latched source rows produce source-diverse outcome gaps under history interventions
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: public no-training outcome probe only; no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if normal rollouts are mostly nonviable
stop if effects are only reset-hidden or zero-current-response positive controls
stop if wrong or delayed warmup history produces action-only effects with no outcome gap
stop if accepted history-positive rows are source-narrow
fallback_plan: route to warmup task/source redesign if history-positive rows are sparse
route to reveal matching redesign if current-frame substitution remains high
route to corpus design only if source-diverse warmup-history outcome gaps appear
route to branch synthesis if the warmup-latched route remains negative

failure_criteria: source or reveal-bucket diversity is not reported
